sn45.40:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the holy life and the goal of the holy life.
sn45.40:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the holy life?
sn45.40:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.40:1.7: This is called the holy life.
sn45.40:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, is the goal of the holy life?
sn45.40:1.9: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion.
sn45.40:1.10: This is called the goal of the holy life.”
